Compare within-P context spread to the common time-varying observable correction; no new pilot, fit, parameter change or clean-reference filter input.
why_not_duplicate: Prior four-context repeats used noisy SOURCE C (lighting trajectory or held source-frame0), not this denoised pilot P trajectory.
RESET/tuning/hit-alpha/oct tests repeated source paths or intervened contract fields. They establish conditional source variability, not native spread under identical pilot P.

Significant-phase initial study has one blind_pilot context per scene and source/null pair. Oracle and independent noisy-stream studies are different inputs, not identical P seven-input replay cohorts.
minimum_protocol: Pinned same runner/provider/tuning/split-derived seven input payloads and184-byte applied controls; source0/1/2 and guides/rayalpha unchanged; no regeneration of P or reuse of a response from a different P.

A four-context same-P cohort is descriptive only. Existing first pilot context may count if every payload/control/B/provider hash matches; preferably retain independently scheduled fresh context identifiers explicitly.

Store every raw lobe output and native manifest/log/guard. For composed T(P), retain actual converter eight outputs and composition CB/input/output bytes; reconstructed conversion must produce seven native input hashes exact to original.
Existing source/null baseline pair remains a separate cohort. Do not use independent contexts as temporal Monte Carlo history or average them into a claimed runtime fix.
Analyze full/mature/early8 RGB-lobe and composed variation, first divergence, bias and full-versus-score ROI; no quality acceptance or unknown-game-correspondence claim.
exact_observable_decomposition: For fixed P(t), delta_r(t)=P(t)-TP_r(t). Thus context-wise variance across r of delta at each t is exactly the context-wise variance of TP.

Let meanTP(t)=mean_r TP_r(t), e_r=TP_r-meanTP, meanDelta=P-meanTP. Averaged over contexts, temporal centered variance(delta_r)=temporal variance(meanDelta)+mean_r temporal variance(e_r), because mean_r e_r(t)=0 and cross term cancels exactly.

The residual cohort spread isolates same-P context-reinitialization variation. The common trajectory includes deterministic native settling, pilot input changes and guide trajectory effects; it cannot by itself identify pilot-noise causation.
interpretation: If same-P responses differ materially, source-null noise is not an adequate estimate of pilot-context variation; paired correction can inherit native context noise.

If same-P responses agree but common correction has excess temporal variation, context stochasticity is not necessary in that measured cohort. Input-dependent response/settling is implicated only as a combined conditional path, not a proven source-pilot-noise mechanism.

This is a narrow context-reinitialization intervention and variance separation. A pure causal claim about pilot input noise would still need a separately frozen input perturbation, not merely ensemble covariance or clean scoring correlation.
